name: Futari-nori
source:
Sasaki, a working adult, returned to his hometown for the Obon holiday but found himself terribly bored.

Aoi, a high school girl who is a close friend of Sasaki's, visits his hometown, wanting to see it for herself.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/7161]Novelgame[/url]]
